  overflow:hidden;
  padding:0;
  position:absolute;
  width:1px;
  word-wrap:normal !important;

  clip-path:none;

  font-size:1em;
  height:auto;

		<section aria-labelledby="our-three-campuses81">
<div id="campuses" class="card text-left large purple img-left" style="width:100%">
<div class="image-large"><img decoding="async" src="https://cdn.uw.edu/wp-content/uploads/sites/79/2023/03/10161132/dubs-three-campuses.jpg"  alt="Two people take a picture with Dubs, the Husky mascot"></div>
<div class="card-body">
<div class="inner-card-body">
<h2 id="our-three-campuses81" class="card-title">Our three campuses</h2>
<p>The UW comprises campuses in Seattle, Bothell and Tacoma, as well as a world-class medical center serving the state and the region. <span style="font-weight: 400;">Each year, the UW inspires more than 60,000 students to learn from renowned experts in their fields. As <a href="https://www.forbes.com/sites/michaeltnietzel/2022/07/19/here-are-fiskes-best-buy-colleges-for-2023/?sh=2789cf811e93">a “best buy” public university</a>, our goal is to make higher education accessible for all.</span></p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<div  class="grid row equal   " >
<div  class="col-sm">
<section aria-labelledby="seattle35">
<div  class="card text-left image-top purple " style="width:100%">
<div class="card-body">
<h2 id="seattle35"   class="card-title mb-0">Seattle</h2>
<div class="card-image-top"><img decoding="async" src="https://cdn.uw.edu/wp-content/uploads/sites/79/2023/03/03145257/makayla-books.jpg" class="card-img card-img-top" alt="Suzzallo"></div>
<div class="udub-slant-divider"><span></span></div>
<div class="card-content">
<p>The UW in Seattle features a campus renowned for its beauty in the midst of a vibrant, multicultural city. Find your community among more than 33,000 undergraduate students, learn from award-winning faculty and discover your path with more than 180 majors to choose from.</p>
</div>
<p class="button"><a href="https://www.washington.edu/about/seattle-campus/" class="btn btn-lg arrow secondary light-gold "><span>Visit Seattle</span><span class="arrow-box"><span class="arrow"></span></span></a></p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</div>
<div  class="col-sm">
<section aria-labelledby="bothell74">
<div  class="card text-left image-top purple " style="width:100%">
<div class="card-body">
<h2 id="bothell74"   class="card-title mb-0">Bothell</h2>
<div class="card-image-top"><img decoding="async" src="https://cdn.uw.edu/wp-content/uploads/sites/79/2023/03/03145255/20180515_UW-Bothell-Tutors_0285.jpg" class="card-img card-img-top" alt="A tutor works with a student."></div>
<div class="udub-slant-divider"><span></span></div>
<div class="card-content">
<p>UW Bothell is a student-centered campus community with 6,000 students, more than 350 faculty, five schools and more than 50 undergraduate and master’s degree programs. It offers the benefits of a small campus with the resources and opportunities of a large university.</p>
</div>
<p class="button"><a href="https://www.uwb.edu/" class="btn btn-lg arrow secondary light-gold "><span>Visit UW Bothell</span><span class="arrow-box"><span class="arrow"></span></span></a></p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</div>
<div  class="col-sm">
<section aria-labelledby="tacoma85">
<div  class="card text-left image-top purple " style="width:100%">
<div class="card-body">
<h2 id="tacoma85"   class="card-title mb-0">Tacoma</h2>
<div class="card-image-top"><img decoding="async" src="https://cdn.uw.edu/wp-content/uploads/sites/79/2023/03/10185053/visit-uw-tacoma-3x2-1.jpg" class="card-img card-img-top" alt="Exterior shot of UW Tacoma building."></div>
<div class="udub-slant-divider"><span></span></div>
<div class="card-content">
<p>UW Tacoma is an urban-serving university community in the heart of downtown Tacoma, closely linked with the South Puget Sound area. Choose from among 40 undergraduate degree programs and 25 minors and certificates in a wide range of fields.</p>
</div>
<p class="button"><a href="https://www.tacoma.uw.edu/" class="btn btn-lg arrow secondary light-gold "><span>Visit UW Tacoma</span><span class="arrow-box"><span class="arrow"></span></span></a></p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</div>
</div>
<section aria-labelledby="uw-medicine98">
<div  class="card text-left large purple img-right" style="width:100%">
<div class="image-large"><img decoding="async" src="https://cdn.uw.edu/wp-content/uploads/sites/79/2023/03/03145239/web-20190606_UW-Bothell-Evergreen-Nursing_0227-750x500-1.jpg"  alt="cupcakes"></div>
<div class="card-body">
<div class="inner-card-body">
<h2 id="uw-medicine98" class="card-title">UW Medicine</h2>
<p>UW Medicine provides comprehensive, state-of-the-art, compassionate care by bringing together a top-rated medical school, an internationally recognized research organization and a large network of medical providers and facilities across the region.</p>
<p>We’re committed to excellence in training the next generation of health professionals and researchers. And with over 1.6 million patient visits and $729 million in uncompensated care for low-income patients in need in 2021, we are dedicated to the health and well-being of Washingtonians statewide.</p>
<p class="button"><a href="https://www.uwmedicine.org/" class="btn btn-lg arrow secondary light-gold"><span>UW Medicine</span><span class="arrow-box"><span class="arrow"></span></span></a></p>
</div>
</div>

</section>
<div style="padding-top: 30px;">

<div  class="card text-left large lightgold img-left" style="width:100%">

<div class="card-body">
<div class="inner-card-body">
<h2 id="world-leaders-in-research72" class="card-title">World leaders in research</h2>
<p>The University of Washington has been recognized as the <a href="https://www.washington.edu/news/2019/10/23/uw-is-most-innovative-u-s-public-university-no-5-in-the-world-according-to-reuters/">#1 most innovative public university</a> in the world and is consistently ranked among the <a href="https://www.washington.edu/news/2024/10/09/uw-ranks-among-best-in-the-world-fourth-among-us-public-institutions/">top public universities</a> in the world.</p>
<p>The UW receives more federal research dollars than any other U.S. public university and has been home to 8 Nobel Prize winners; 17 MacArthur Fellows; 189 members of the National Academies of Sciences, Engineering, and Medicine; and 193 fellows in the American Association for the Advancement of Science.</p>
<p class="button"><a href="https://research.washington.edu/" class="btn btn-lg arrow white"><span>Research Impact</span><span class="arrow-box"><span class="arrow"></span></span></a></p>
</div>
</div>

https://www.washington.edu/about/?utm_so.visible_text: About the UW Skip to content All the UW Current site Search scope All the UW Current site Enter search text MyUW Calendar Directories Libraries UW Medicine Maps UW News Helpful Links Information Technology Workday HCM Husky Card UW Bothell UW Tacoma UW Facebook UW Twitter University of Washington University of Washington Students Parents Faculty & Staff Alumni Quick Links Menu About About the UW Diversity Global Impact Innovation Leadership Maps Population Health Sustainability Visit Academics Academics at the UW Academic calendar Academic departments Colleges and schools Course descriptions Registration Student guide Time schedule Apply Admissions Financial Aid Continuing education Majors Student housing Transfer students Tuition and fees UW Online News & Events UW News Featured stories Arts UW Calendar UW Magazine Husky sports Newsletter Research Research at the UW Office of Research Research Lifecycle Centers and Institutes Stats and rankings Campuses Bothell Seattle Tacoma Give Give now Ways to give My UW Giving About the UW Since our founding in 1861, the University of Washington has been a hub for learning, innovation, problem solving and community building. Driven by a mission to serve the greater good, our students, faculty and staff tackle today’s most pressing challenges with courage and creativity, making a difference across Washington state — and around the world. Apply to the UW Our three campuses The UW comprises campuses in Seattle, Bothell and Tacoma, as well as a world-class medical center serving the state and the region. Each year, the UW inspires more than 60,000 students to learn from renowned experts in their fields. As a “best buy” public university , our goal is to make higher education accessible for all. Seattle The UW in Seattle features a campus renowned for its beauty in the midst of a vibrant, multicultural city. Find your community among more than 33,000 undergraduate students, learn from award-winning faculty and discover your path with more than 180 majors to choose from. Visit Seattle Bothell UW Bothell is a student-centered campus community with 6,000 students, more than 350 faculty, five schools and more than 50 undergraduate and master’s degree programs. It offers the benefits of a small campus with the resources and opportunities of a large university. Visit UW Bothell Tacoma UW Tacoma is an urban-serving university community in the heart of downtown Tacoma, closely linked with the South Puget Sound area. Choose from among 40 undergraduate degree programs and 25 minors and certificates in a wide range of fields. Visit UW Tacoma UW Medicine UW Medicine provides comprehensive, state-of-the-art, compassionate care by bringing together a top-rated medical school, an internationally recognized research organization and a large network of medical providers and facilities across the region. We’re committed to excellence in training the next generation of health professionals and researchers. And with over 1.6 million patient visits and $729 million in uncompensated care for low-income patients in need in 2021, we are dedicated to the health and well-being of Washingtonians statewide. UW Medicine World leaders in research The University of Washington has been recognized as the #1 most innovative public university in the world and is consistently ranked among the top public universities in the world. The UW receives more federal research dollars than any other U.S. public university and has been home to 8 Nobel Prize winners; 17 MacArthur Fellows; 189 members of the National Academies of Sciences, Engineering, and Medicine; and 193 fellows in the American Association for the Advancement of Science. Research Impact Stories of impact Read about the people, places and programs that drive the University of Washington’s faculty, staff and students to work for a world of good. Featured stories UW News releases Fossil feathers preserved inside dinosaur poop could help explain why some birds survived the dinosaur mass extinction 1 day ago UW, WA Department of Health show it’s possible to test wastewater for STIs 1 day ago More from UW News Subscribe to our monthly newsletter Sign up for UW Current to discover the latest on new innovations, useful tips and information, and eye-opening stories coming out of the UW community. University Leadership “The UW is globally renowned as a home of outstanding teaching, research, innovation and patient care.” Robert J. Jones University of Washington President Professor of Biology Learn more about the UW’s president , provost , board of regents and faculty senate . UW Leadership UW AND THE COMMUNITY Global impact As one of the world’s most innovative universities, we know the importance of a global perspective. We’re proud to deliver on our mission of education, discovery and public service — with programs and research across Washington state and across every continent. Learn more Alumni association No matter where you are, if you believe in higher education, supporting students, lifelong learning or cheering on the Dawgs, the University of Washington Alumni Association connects you to what matters. Get involved UW in your community From researching in the foothills of Mount Rainier to training medical students in Seattle and Spokane, the UW is truly the University for Washington. <article id="post-3716" class="post-3716 page type-page status-publish has-post-thumbnail hentry">
	<div class="entry-content">

		<section aria-labelledby="our-three-campuses81">
<div id="campuses" class="card text-left large purple img-left" style="width:100%">
<div class="image-large"><img decoding="async" src="https://cdn.uw.edu/wp-content/uploads/sites/79/2023/03/10161132/dubs-three-campuses.jpg"  alt="Two people take a picture with Dubs, the Husky mascot"></div>
<div class="card-body">
<div class="inner-card-body">
<h2 id="our-three-campuses81" class="card-title">Our three campuses</h2>
<p>The UW comprises campuses in Seattle, Bothell and Tacoma, as well as a world-class medical center serving the state and the region. <span style="font-weight: 400;">Each year, the UW inspires more than 60,000 students to learn from renowned experts in their fields. As <a href="https://www.forbes.com/sites/michaeltnietzel/2022/07/19/here-are-fiskes-best-buy-colleges-for-2023/?sh=2789cf811e93">a “best buy” public university</a>, our goal is to make higher education accessible for all.</span></p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<div  class="grid row equal   " >
<div  class="col-sm">
<section aria-labelledby="seattle35">
<div  class="card text-left image-top purple " style="width:100%">
<div class="card-body">
<h2 id="seattle35"   class="card-title mb-0">Seattle</h2>
<div class="card-image-top"><img decoding="async" src="https://cdn.uw.edu/wp-content/uploads/sites/79/2023/03/03145257/makayla-books.jpg" class="card-img card-img-top" alt="Suzzallo"></div>
<div class="udub-slant-divider"><span></span></div>
<div class="card-content">
<p>The UW in Seattle features a campus renowned for its beauty in the midst of a vibrant, multicultural city. Find your community among more than 33,000 undergraduate students, learn from award-winning faculty and discover your path with more than 180 majors to choose from.</p>
</div>
<p class="button"><a href="https://www.washington.edu/about/seattle-campus/" class="btn btn-lg arrow secondary light-gold "><span>Visit Seattle</span><span class="arrow-box"><span class="arrow"></span></span></a></p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</div>
<div  class="col-sm">
<section aria-labelledby="bothell74">
<div  class="card text-left image-top purple " style="width:100%">
<div class="card-body">
<h2 id="bothell74"   class="card-title mb-0">Bothell</h2>
<div class="card-image-top"><img decoding="async" src="https://cdn.uw.edu/wp-content/uploads/sites/79/2023/03/03145255/20180515_UW-Bothell-Tutors_0285.jpg" class="card-img card-img-top" alt="A tutor works with a student."></div>
<div class="udub-slant-divider"><span></span></div>
<div class="card-content">
<p>UW Bothell is a student-centered campus community with 6,000 students, more than 350 faculty, five schools and more than 50 undergraduate and master’s degree programs. It offers the benefits of a small campus with the resources and opportunities of a large university.</p>
</div>
<p class="button"><a href="https://www.uwb.edu/" class="btn btn-lg arrow secondary light-gold "><span>Visit UW Bothell</span><span class="arrow-box"><span class="arrow"></span></span></a></p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</div>
<div  class="col-sm">
<section aria-labelledby="tacoma85">
<div  class="card text-left image-top purple " style="width:100%">
<div class="card-body">
<h2 id="tacoma85"   class="card-title mb-0">Tacoma</h2>
<div class="card-image-top"><img decoding="async" src="https://cdn.uw.edu/wp-content/uploads/sites/79/2023/03/10185053/visit-uw-tacoma-3x2-1.jpg" class="card-img card-img-top" alt="Exterior shot of UW Tacoma building."></div>
<div class="udub-slant-divider"><span></span></div>
<div class="card-content">
<p>UW Tacoma is an urban-serving university community in the heart of downtown Tacoma, closely linked with the South Puget Sound area. Choose from among 40 undergraduate degree programs and 25 minors and certificates in a wide range of fields.</p>
</div>

<div class="card-body">
<div class="inner-card-body">
<h2 id="uw-medicine98" class="card-title">UW Medicine</h2>
<p>UW Medicine provides comprehensive, state-of-the-art, compassionate care by bringing together a top-rated medical school, an internationally recognized research organization and a large network of medical providers and facilities across the region.</p>
<p>We’re committed to excellence in training the next generation of health professionals and researchers. And with over 1.6 million patient visits and $729 million in uncompensated care for low-income patients in need in 2021, we are dedicated to the health and well-being of Washingtonians statewide.</p>
<p class="button"><a href="https://www.uwmedicine.org/" class="btn btn-lg arrow secondary light-gold"><span>UW Medicine</span><span class="arrow-box"><span class="arrow"></span></span></a></p>

<div class="card-body">
<div class="inner-card-body">
<h2 id="world-leaders-in-research72" class="card-title">World leaders in research</h2>
<p>The University of Washington has been recognized as the <a href="https://www.washington.edu/news/2019/10/23/uw-is-most-innovative-u-s-public-university-no-5-in-the-world-according-to-reuters/">#1 most innovative public university</a> in the world and is consistently ranked among the <a href="https://www.washington.edu/news/2024/10/09/uw-ranks-among-best-in-the-world-fourth-among-us-public-institutions/">top public universities</a> in the world.</p>
<p>The UW receives more federal research dollars than any other U.S. public university and has been home to 8 Nobel Prize winners; 17 MacArthur Fellows; 189 members of the National Academies of Sciences, Engineering, and Medicine; and 193 fellows in the American Association for the Advancement of Science.</p>
<p class="button"><a href="https://research.washington.edu/" class="btn btn-lg arrow white"><span>Research Impact</span><span class="arrow-box"><span class="arrow"></span></span></a></p>

		<section aria-labelledby="our-three-campuses81">
<div id="campuses" class="card text-left large purple img-left" style="width:100%">
<div class="image-large"><img decoding="async" src="https://cdn.uw.edu/wp-content/uploads/sites/79/2023/03/10161132/dubs-three-campuses.jpg"  alt="Two people take a picture with Dubs, the Husky mascot"></div>
<div class="card-body">
<div class="inner-card-body">
<h2 id="our-three-campuses81" class="card-title">Our three campuses</h2>
<p>The UW comprises campuses in Seattle, Bothell and Tacoma, as well as a world-class medical center serving the state and the region. <span style="font-weight: 400;">Each year, the UW inspires more than 60,000 students to learn from renowned experts in their fields. As <a href="https://www.forbes.com/sites/michaeltnietzel/2022/07/19/here-are-fiskes-best-buy-colleges-for-2023/?sh=2789cf811e93">a “best buy” public university</a>, our goal is to make higher education accessible for all.</span></p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<div  class="grid row equal   " >
<div  class="col-sm">
<section aria-labelledby="seattle35">
<div  class="card text-left image-top purple " style="width:100%">
<div class="card-body">
<h2 id="seattle35"   class="card-title mb-0">Seattle</h2>
<div class="card-image-top"><img decoding="async" src="https://cdn.uw.edu/wp-content/uploads/sites/79/2023/03/03145257/makayla-books.jpg" class="card-img card-img-top" alt="Suzzallo"></div>
<div class="udub-slant-divider"><span></span></div>
<div class="card-content">
<p>The UW in Seattle features a campus renowned for its beauty in the midst of a vibrant, multicultural city. Find your community among more than 33,000 undergraduate students, learn from award-winning faculty and discover your path with more than 180 majors to choose from.</p>
</div>
<p class="button"><a href="https://www.washington.edu/about/seattle-campus/" class="btn btn-lg arrow secondary light-gold "><span>Visit Seattle</span><span class="arrow-box"><span class="arrow"></span></span></a></p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</div>
<div  class="col-sm">
<section aria-labelledby="bothell74">
<div  class="card text-left image-top purple " style="width:100%">
<div class="card-body">
<h2 id="bothell74"   class="card-title mb-0">Bothell</h2>
<div class="card-image-top"><img decoding="async" src="https://cdn.uw.edu/wp-content/uploads/sites/79/2023/03/03145255/20180515_UW-Bothell-Tutors_0285.jpg" class="card-img card-img-top" alt="A tutor works with a student."></div>
<div class="udub-slant-divider"><span></span></div>
<div class="card-content">
<p>UW Bothell is a student-centered campus community with 6,000 students, more than 350 faculty, five schools and more than 50 undergraduate and master’s degree programs. It offers the benefits of a small campus with the resources and opportunities of a large university.</p>
</div>
<p class="button"><a href="https://www.uwb.edu/" class="btn btn-lg arrow secondary light-gold "><span>Visit UW Bothell</span><span class="arrow-box"><span class="arrow"></span></span></a></p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</div>
<div  class="col-sm">
<section aria-labelledby="tacoma85">
<div  class="card text-left image-top purple " style="width:100%">
<div class="card-body">
<h2 id="tacoma85"   class="card-title mb-0">Tacoma</h2>
<div class="card-image-top"><img decoding="async" src="https://cdn.uw.edu/wp-content/uploads/sites/79/2023/03/10185053/visit-uw-tacoma-3x2-1.jpg" class="card-img card-img-top" alt="Exterior shot of UW Tacoma building."></div>
<div class="udub-slant-divider"><span></span></div>
<div class="card-content">
<p>UW Tacoma is an urban-serving university community in the heart of downtown Tacoma, closely linked with the South Puget Sound area. Choose from among 40 undergraduate degree programs and 25 minors and certificates in a wide range of fields.</p>
</div>
<p class="button"><a href="https://www.tacoma.uw.edu/" class="btn btn-lg arrow secondary light-gold "><span>Visit UW Tacoma</span><span class="arrow-box"><span class="arrow"></span></span></a></p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</div>
</div>
<section aria-labelledby="uw-medicine98">
<div  class="card text-left large purple img-right" style="width:100%">
<div class="image-large"><img decoding="async" src="https://cdn.uw.edu/wp-content/uploads/sites/79/2023/03/03145239/web-20190606_UW-Bothell-Evergreen-Nursing_0227-750x500-1.jpg"  alt="cupcakes"></div>
<div class="card-body">
<div class="inner-card-body">
<h2 id="uw-medicine98" class="card-title">UW Medicine</h2>
<p>UW Medicine provides comprehensive, state-of-the-art, compassionate care by bringing together a top-rated medical school, an internationally recognized research organization and a large network of medical providers and facilities across the region.</p>
<p>We’re committed to excellence in training the next generation of health professionals and researchers. And with over 1.6 million patient visits and $729 million in uncompensated care for low-income patients in need in 2021, we are dedicated to the health and well-being of Washingtonians statewide.</p>
<p class="button"><a href="https://www.uwmedicine.org/" class="btn btn-lg arrow secondary light-gold"><span>UW Medicine</span><span class="arrow-box"><span class="arrow"></span></span></a></p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>

<section aria-labelledby="world-leaders-in-research72">
<div  class="card text-left large lightgold img-left" style="width:100%">

<div class="card-body">
<div class="inner-card-body">
<h2 id="world-leaders-in-research72" class="card-title">World leaders in research</h2>
<p>The University of Washington has been recognized as the <a href="https://www.washington.edu/news/2019/10/23/uw-is-most-innovative-u-s-public-university-no-5-in-the-world-according-to-reuters/">#1 most innovative public university</a> in the world and is consistently ranked among the <a href="https://www.washington.edu/news/2024/10/09/uw-ranks-among-best-in-the-world-fourth-among-us-public-institutions/">top public universities</a> in the world.</p>
<p>The UW receives more federal research dollars than any other U.S. public university and has been home to 8 Nobel Prize winners; 17 MacArthur Fellows; 189 members of the National Academies of Sciences, Engineering, and Medicine; and 193 fellows in the American Association for the Advancement of Science.</p>
<p class="button"><a href="https://research.washington.edu/" class="btn btn-lg arrow white"><span>Research Impact</span><span class="arrow-box"><span class="arrow"></span></span></a></p>
</div>

<section aria-labelledby="global-impact1">
<div  class="card text-left image-top white " style="width:100%">
<div class="card-body">
<h2 id="global-impact1"   class="card-title mb-0">Global impact</h2>
<div class="card-image-top"><img decoding="async" src="https://cdn.uw.edu/wp-content/uploads/sites/79/2023/03/03145248/seattle-campus-18-375x249-1.jpg" class="card-img card-img-top" alt="Seattle flyover at night"></div>
<div class="udub-slant-divider"><span></span></div>
<div class="card-content">
<p>As one of the world’s most innovative universities, we know the importance of a global perspective. We’re proud to deliver on our mission of education, discovery and public service — with programs and research across Washington state and across every continent.</p>
</div>
<p class="button"><a href="https://www.washington.edu/global/a-global-university/" class="btn btn-lg arrow primary purple "><span>Learn more</span><span class="arrow-box"><span class="arrow"></span></span></a></p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</div>
<div  class="col-sm">
<section aria-labelledby="alumni-association28">
<div  class="card text-left image-top white " style="width:100%">
<div class="card-body">
<h2 id="alumni-association28"   class="card-title mb-0">Alumni association</h2>
<div class="card-image-top"><img decoding="async" src="https://cdn.uw.edu/wp-content/uploads/sites/79/2023/03/03145247/web-2018_11_03_UW-1041.jpg" class="card-img card-img-top" alt="Family dressed in Husky gear"></div>
<div class="udub-slant-divider"><span></span></div>
<div class="card-content">
<p>No matter where you are, if you believe in higher education, supporting students, lifelong learning or cheering on the Dawgs, the University of Washington Alumni Association connects you to what matters.</p>
</div>
<p class="button"><a href="https://www.washington.edu/alumni/" class="btn btn-lg arrow primary purple "><span>Get involved</span><span class="arrow-box"><span class="arrow"></span></span></a></p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</div>
<div  class="col-sm">
<section aria-labelledby="uw-in-your-community8">
<div  class="card text-left image-top white " style="width:100%">
<div class="card-body">
<h2 id="uw-in-your-community8"   class="card-title mb-0">UW in your community</h2>
<div class="card-image-top"><img decoding="async" src="https://cdn.uw.edu/wp-content/uploads/sites/79/2021/03/11195241/20180614_Spokane-Spring_4-MP.jpg" class="card-img card-img-top" alt=""></div>
<div class="udub-slant-divider"><span></span></div>
<div class="card-content">
<p>From researching in the foothills of Mount Rainier to training medical students in Seattle and Spokane, the UW is truly the University <em>for</em> Washington.</p>
</div>
<p class="button"><a href="https://www.washington.edu/staterelations/uw-in-your-community/" class="btn btn-lg arrow primary purple "><span>Explore projects</span><span class="arrow-box"><span class="arrow"></span></span></a></p>

https://www.washington.edu/about/?utm_so.visible_text: About the UW Skip to content All the UW Current site Search scope All the UW Current site Enter search text MyUW Calendar Directories Libraries UW Medicine Maps UW News Helpful Links Information Technology Workday HCM Husky Card UW Bothell UW Tacoma UW Facebook UW Twitter University of Washington University of Washington Students Parents Faculty & Staff Alumni Quick Links Menu About About the UW Diversity Global Impact Innovation Leadership Maps Population Health Sustainability Visit Academics Academics at the UW Academic calendar Academic departments Colleges and schools Course descriptions Registration Student guide Time schedule Apply Admissions Financial Aid Continuing education Majors Student housing Transfer students Tuition and fees UW Online News & Events UW News Featured stories Arts UW Calendar UW Magazine Husky sports Newsletter Research Research at the UW Office of Research Research Lifecycle Centers and Institutes Stats and rankings Campuses Bothell Seattle Tacoma Give Give now Ways to give My UW Giving About the UW Since our founding in 1861, the University of Washington has been a hub for learning, innovation, problem solving and community building. Driven by a mission to serve the greater good, our students, faculty and staff tackle today’s most pressing challenges with courage and creativity, making a difference across Washington state — and around the world. Apply to the UW Our three campuses The UW comprises campuses in Seattle, Bothell and Tacoma, as well as a world-class medical center serving the state and the region. Each year, the UW inspires more than 60,000 students to learn from renowned experts in their fields. As a “best buy” public university , our goal is to make higher education accessible for all. Seattle The UW in Seattle features a campus renowned for its beauty in the midst of a vibrant, multicultural city. Find your community among more than 33,000 undergraduate students, learn from award-winning faculty and discover your path with more than 180 majors to choose from. Visit Seattle Bothell UW Bothell is a student-centered campus community with 6,000 students, more than 350 faculty, five schools and more than 50 undergraduate and master’s degree programs. It offers the benefits of a small campus with the resources and opportunities of a large university. Visit UW Bothell Tacoma UW Tacoma is an urban-serving university community in the heart of downtown Tacoma, closely linked with the South Puget Sound area. Choose from among 40 undergraduate degree programs and 25 minors and certificates in a wide range of fields. Visit UW Tacoma UW Medicine UW Medicine provides comprehensive, state-of-the-art, compassionate care by bringing together a top-rated medical school, an internationally recognized research organization and a large network of medical providers and facilities across the region. We’re committed to excellence in training the next generation of health professionals and researchers. And with over 1.6 million patient visits and $729 million in uncompensated care for low-income patients in need in 2021, we are dedicated to the health and well-being of Washingtonians statewide. UW Medicine World leaders in research The University of Washington has been recognized as the #1 most innovative public university in the world and is consistently ranked among the top public universities in the world. The UW receives more federal research dollars than any other U.S. public university and has been home to 8 Nobel Prize winners; 17 MacArthur Fellows; 189 members of the National Academies of Sciences, Engineering, and Medicine; and 193 fellows in the American Association for the Advancement of Science. Research Impact Stories of impact Read about the people, places and programs that drive the University of Washington’s faculty, staff and students to work for a world of good.
